title: Tapes mention coupling to the computer data bank

tellings.quote: cuz on a lot of the tapes there's mention of um coupling to the computer data bank

plain: An unnamed researcher on a podcast describes recordings of 1970s sessions run by a scientist named Puharich, in which people said they were in contact with non-human intelligences. The researcher says many of the tapes mention "coupling to the computer data bank", a phrase from those sessions. If taken at face value, it would suggest the voices described some kind of link to a vast store of information.
